It is applied in `parse_node()` (around line 94–97), which loops over the lines `links_section()` returns, i.e. only lines under `## Links`. For `- replaced by [[jack-swigert]]`, group 1 gives the reason `replaced by` and group 2 gives the written target `jack-swigert`. Each match is stored as a `(line, reason, written_as)` tuple on `Node.links`. `count_raw_links()` (around line 194) counts `[[...]]` separately and does not use this regex.

FILES: `app/src/yggdras/data/graph/structural.py` (lines 25–98 read; the rest was located through the graph)
